title: A Primer of the Flat Ring
summary: Teaches how to hold and carry a flat steel ring and throw it with body strength alone to beginners.

title: Handbook of the Finger Spin
summary: Shows a beginner how to whirl the ring on one finger and fling it from the fingertip.

title: Drill-Book of the Open Hoop
summary: Drills a level stance and straight and arcing throws at marked posts so the thrower's aim grows even.

title: First Lessons in the Rimmed Quoit
summary: Teaches the release point of the arm swing and the plain hand-held cut with the ring's rim.

title: Workbook of Ring Catching
summary: Trains the hardened beginner to stop and catch a returning ring safely and throw it back at once.

title: Treatise on the Spun Edge
summary: Teaches a student who circulates qi to warm the ring's rim and throw it edge first.

title: A Short Canon of the Thrown Ring
summary: Sets out the cross-body draw and the overarm throw and how to lend a little qi to the flight.

title: Handbook of the Skimming Disc
summary: Explains low skimming throws that slide under a guard and curve up into the target.

title: Ring-Thrower's Daily Practice
summary: Lays out a full day of wrist conditioning and counted throws for a qi-using beginner.

title: Primer of the Carried Rings
summary: Teaches how to carry several rings on the arm and belt and draw them quietly in order.
